title: Liam Coen: Sunday about us, not who's missing for Eagles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Liam Coen: Sunday about us, not who's missing for Eagles
sources.description: It's been a tumultuous week for the Eagles, but Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said that's not factoring into his team's preparation for Sunday's game in London.
